newsitem.title: UK: Prudential gains after new business report.
newsitem.headline: Prudential gains after new business report.

text.p: Shares in Prudential Corp Plc rose on Thursday after a strong first-quarter new business report from the insurance group, analysts said.
The stock was up 7p or 1.2 percent at 574-1/2 by 0831 GMT, among the strongest performers in the FTSE 100 index. Volume reached a modest 245,729 shares.
Charles Landa, analyst at SocGen, said they were "obviously very good figures" and highlighted the strong performance by the Pru's Jackson National Life unit in the United States.
Derek Elias, analyst at Paribas Capital Markets, also said he retained a "buy" on the Pru though he said the figures were only "good in parts."
Elias also highlighted the company's U.S. performance as the strongest feature of the statement but said the UK figures were a "bit dull."
In its statement the Pru said worldwide single-premium sales were up 22 percent in the first quarter of 1997 and its regular premium sales were up 17 percent.

In the U.S., single-premium sales rose 79 percent to $1.1 billion, with variable annuities and a new equity-linked annuity product range attracting a combined $270 million of sales compared with $29 billion in the first quarter of 1996. -- David Holmes, London Newsroom +44 171 542 4367
